name: Pidilite Industries Ltd

ledger.quote: So I think to answer your question, would we be deploying the expansion, if at all, in gross margin for investments? The answer is yes. We will be deploying them judiciously in A&SP, in GTM capability building.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.target: Deploy gross margin gains into A&SP and GTM
ledger.verdict: Management stated they deployed gross margin gains into A&SP and GTM, matching their promise.
ledger.evidence: However, total costs below gross margin increased slower than the revenue growth. The total cost increase was 14.5%. A large chunk of that was advertising and sales promotion and this operating leverage flowed into the EBITDA.

ledger.quote: If the raw material prices remain benign, for the year will we definitely remain within the corridor, a little bit on the higher end of the corridor, the answer is yes.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Full year OPM reached 24%, hitting the upper end of the 20% to 24% range.

ledger.quote: We stay committed to our corridor of 20% to 24%. As you saw in first half, we are at the higher end of that corridor, we are actually at about 24%.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 reached 26.4%, maintaining commitment to the corridor.
ledger.evidence: EBITDA margins at 26.4% improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and profit after tax grew by 27.7%.

ledger.quote: So what we are saying is that this momentum of mid-teens domestic B2B(which also has projects)we are confident that, that momentum will continue.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: Rather than saying when will it be substantial, I will say that in the immediate or medium-term defined as let's say, 6 months or 12 months, some of these initiatives which we are showing now are not going to be material to the size of Pidilite.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Initiatives are still within the 6 to 12 months horizon without being material yet.

ledger.quote: We've demonstrated that we've delivered double-digit underlying volume growth for some quarters, and we are confident that we can do it in the future. You're absolutely right.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Underlying volume growth in Consumer and Bazaar reached 12.2% in Q1 FY27, delivering double-digit growth.
ledger.evidence: If you look at the underlying volume growth for the quarter, Consumer and Bazaar businesses, underlying volume growth was 12.2%

ledger.quote: If you look at our 9 months consolidated growth, that is around 10%. So therefore, you are seeing a fillip in the growth.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: And our focus, Abneesh, as I'm telling again and again, Sandeep and I have been absolutely reiterating is to drive underlying volume growth to drive demand and to stay steadfast on growth.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Underlying volume growth was prioritized and driven, resulting in 11.3% standalone UVG.
ledger.evidence: Standalone revenues grew by 22.2% with an underlying volume growth of 11.3%.

ledger.quote: So our capex in the year also was higher than what we had spent in the previous year. With this, I open the floor for Q&A.
ledger.speaker: Sandeep Batra
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

open.quote: As a matter of fact, our endeavor will be to slowly but surely inch it up a little bit.
open.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats

read: Management consistently meets its guidance ranges for EBITDA margins and volume growth. Their operational execution matches their stated targets.
questions: When will new initiatives like UnoFin contribute materially to revenues?
How will export headwinds impact B2B export recovery in coming quarters?
bull: Standalone revenues grew by 22.2% with an underlying volume growth of 11.3%.
Consolidated PAT grew by 30.3% in Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin improved to 26.4% in Q1 FY27.
bear: B2B exports UVG was negative 8.4% for the quarter.
Gross margins at 52.5% were lower than the previous year by 90 basis points.
